# MemoryEfficientSimulation

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A simulation approach that reduces peak memory footprint while maintaining accuracy for quantum circuit execution. Enables larger quantum circuits to be simulated on resource-constrained interconnect hardware, bridging quantum and classical computing.
